ITEM 1 | Diced cooked light-meat pieces, pale beige with slight golden edges, irregular cubes about 1-1.5 cm, moist-looking, firm, scattered across upper-left of plate covering roughly 20% of plate area, piled a few pieces high | 130
ITEM 2 | Whole and halved cooked brown mushrooms, caps smooth and glossy with light browning, about 2-3 cm diameter, sitting in a cluster below the diced pale pieces, covering roughly 10% of plate area, about 1.5 cm tall | 80
ITEM 3 | Roasted Brussels sprouts, dark green to charred brown outer leaves, halved and whole, about 2-3 cm, slightly shiny, covering roughly 6% of plate area in upper-right, a few cm high | 60
ITEM 4 | Roasted yellow potato wedges and chunks, golden-yellow with browned edges and darker caramelized spots, irregular pieces about 2-3 cm, slightly glossy, arranged along right edge covering roughly 12% of plate area, 1-2 cm high | 110
ITEM 5 | Cooked white rice, short-grain, moist and clumped, pearly white with some separated grains, mounded in a rounded heap about 8 cm across covering roughly 15% of plate area, about 2 cm high, sitting beside the pizza slice | 150
ITEM 6 | Single triangular slice of thin-crust pizza, golden-brown crust with blistered edges, topped with red tomato sauce and melted pale cheese with light browning, slice about 12 cm long and 5 cm wide at base, about 1 cm thick, covering roughly 9% of plate area at lower-left | 110
